bassmusik.text: Dubstep-style wobble bass: saw and pulse into a ladder filter with LFO and growl.

diode-acid-bass.text: Acid bass with a diode ladder filter; squelchy and resonant.

diode-goa-linie.text: Rolling goa bass line: diode ladder filter, saw plus pulse; works for fast 16th lines.

drums-808.text: 808-style drum kit: boomy kick, snappy snare, hats; MIDI notes pick the drums.

drums-909.text: 909-style drum kit: punchy kick, clap and snare, crisp hats; MIDI notes pick the drums.

falter-demo.text: Wavefolder demo: saw folded into rich harmonics; fold and symmetry change the timbre.

fm-bass.text: FM bass: tight, bright and punchy, with fast decay and feedback bite.

fm-epiano.text: FM electric piano with tremolo and chorus; soft bell-like attack.

fm-glocke.text: FM bell with hall; clear, ringing and metallic.

fm-lead.text: FM lead with vibrato and echo; bright, glassy and cutting.

formant-neuro-bass.text: Neuro bass with a moving vowel filter; talks and growls in drum and bass style.

gated-hall-snare.text: Big gated-reverb snare in 80s style; one hit per key, tail length on a knob.

goa-blubber-lead.text: Goa lead with sample-and-hold bubbling on a ladder filter; trippy and rubbery.

granular-drone.text: Dark drone from grains of a saw wave; freeze it for endless texture.

granular-pad.text: Soft evolving pad built from sound grains; slow, wide and shimmering.

granular-textur.text: Grainy texture generator; density and grain size from clouds to crackle.

hartsync-bass.text: Hard-sync bass with a pitch zap on every note; aggressive, screaming low end.

hartsync-lead.text: Hard-sync lead with a pitch sweep; the classic screaming sync solo sound.

hartsync-pad.text: Hard-sync pad with a slow sweep, PWM and chorus; moving, edgy texture.

juno-pad.text: Chorus pad: PWM, sub and chorus; warm and lush for chords.

juno-pad-dyn.text: Chorus pad with echo, hall and compressor built in; ready-made wide chords.

juno-pad-echo.text: Chorus pad with a tempo-friendly echo and hall; spacious chords.

juno-pad-hall.text: Chorus pad with a big hall; long, airy chords.

kamm-goa-zupf.text: Plucked goa tone from a tuned comb filter; short, hollow and bubbly.

kick-synth.text: Synthesized sine kick tuned in Hz: pitch envelope, click, drive and a polarity switch.

lead.text: Sync lead: two saws, hard sync, filter envelope and vibrato; cuts through a mix.

metall-crash.text: Metallic crash cymbal with choke on release; for accents and fills.

metall-hihat.text: Closed and open hi-hat from metallic oscillators; for steady 8th and 16th patterns.

metall-ride.text: Ringing ride cymbal from metallic oscillators; for steady ride patterns.

ms20-bass.text: Twin-filter bass: raw, screaming filter with drive; gritty and edgy.

ms20-goa-lead.text: Twin-filter goa lead: biting filter, LFO and detune; psychedelic and sharp.

mseg-neuro-bass.text: Neuro bass whose cutoff follows a multi-segment envelope; deep, evolving movement.

resonator-conga.text: Struck conga from a resonator model; damping and strike position shape the hit.

resonator-glocke.text: Struck bell from a resonator model; material and size change the metal.

resonator-marimba.text: Marimba from a resonator model; mallet hardness and strike position shape the wood.

resonator-metall.text: Struck metal bar or plate from a resonator model; inharmonic and ringing.

roehre-lead.text: Warm saw lead through a tube stage; drive and cutoff for a singing, fat tone.

rueckkopplung.text: Feedback-string bass tone that sings and bites; tune, colour and feedback on knobs.

saege-ladder.text: Plain saw through a ladder filter; a bare starting point for leads and basses.

saite.text: Simple plucked string: a short delay loop with noise burst; Karplus-Strong style.

saite-gitarre.text: Plucked guitar string with body resonance; pick position and damping on knobs.

saite-harfe.text: Plucked harp string; bright attack and long ring.

saite-karplus.text: Bare Karplus-Strong pluck; plain string sound without body.

saite-klavier.text: Piano string model with hammer and soundboard; damper control on a knob.

sampler-fairlight.text: Fairlight-style orchestra hit sampler with slices and reverse; crunchy and retro.

sem-house-akkord.text: State-variable house chord stab: filter envelope with a morphing filter shape.

sem-pad.text: State-variable pad with a morphing filter that sweeps slowly; smooth and analog.

synth-mono.text: Full mono synth for bass and lead: two oscillators, sub, five switchable filters.

synth-neuro.text: Complete neuro and reese bass machine: detuned saws, FM, fold, formant and filter moves.

synth-poly.text: Polyphonic unison synth with ladder, SV and diode filters: stabs, supersaws, pads.

wavetable-chor.text: Choir-like pad from a vowel wavetable; the vowel moves slowly.

wavetable-reese.text: Reese bass from detuned wavetable oscillators; wide, dark and growling.

wavetable-supersaw.text: Wide supersaw from detuned wavetable oscillators; trance chords and big leads.

labor.text: Feedback synth: a note pings two resonant filters, one echoes the other.
